tagline: 美能达取景器相机，1989 年发布
description: 美能达于1989年推出的取景器相机。配备35 mm f/4,5。快门速度Behind-the-lens mechanical shutter, fixed at 1/125 s.。使用Automatic advance and rewind.。感光度DX coded films, ISO 100 or 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.。Fixed focus from 1,5 m to infinity.。

specs.快门: Behind-the-lens mechanical shutter, fixed at 1/125 s.
specs.对焦: Fixed focus from 1,5 m to infinity.
specs.曝光测光: f/8 without flash, f/4,5 with flash.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in, manually activated. Range: 1,5–4 m. LED indicator for low light and flash ready signal.
specs.感光度: DX coded films, ISO 100 or 400. Non-DX films exposed as ISO 100.
specs.英文简介: The Minolta FS-35, known as the Freedom 50 in America, is a basic fixed-focus compact camera released circa 1989.
